nodes.title: Note: Usage
widgets_values:
## Size
Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Output size comes from ResolutionSelector (width/height). Default is 1 megapixel (1024*1024). For native 2K, set 1:1 and 4 megapixels (2048*2048). Prefer multiples of 32.

## Transparent Image

To generate a transparent image, wrap the prompt like this and replace the middle with the subject:

---
This is an RGBA format image with transparency. `[your description]`. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

---
Save as PNG to keep the alpha channel.

## Parameters

- prompt: what to generate. For RGBA, see Note: transparent.
- negative_prompt: unused while cfg is 1.
- cfg: keep 1 for the Qwen Image 2.1 official path. Raise it only if you use a negative prompt.
- steps: Qwen Image 2.1 official  pipeline uses about 40-50 with euler. This template starts at 25. More advanced samplers need fewer steps.

widgets_values: Greyscale fashion editorial portrait of an avant-garde woman tilted upwards in profile, captured with striking high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting. She wears oversized, thick-rimmed circular black sunglasses with matte dark lenses, concealing her upward gaze. Her attire merges high couture with tactical abstraction: a high-necked structural dress tailored from heavyweight fabric featuring a disrupted optical camouflage pattern—interlocking oversized polka dots, pixelated stippling, and organic contour blotches in stark monochrome that mimic military disruptive patterns in a refined runway style. Around her shoulders, asymmetric pleated webbing and tailored cargo straps are integrated seamlessly into the garment’s architecture. In her gloved hand, she clutches a structured matte-leather geometric handbag accented with subtle tactical buckles, utility stitching, and dark brushed-metal hardware. Her skin texture is rendered with hyper-detailed clarity, sculpted by intense, razor-sharp studio key light and deep graphite shadows. The striking background is a vivid mixed-media graphic collage, composed of flat vibrant lime green planes, stark black and white overlapping circles, segmented semi-circles with bold zebra striping, dense micro-halftone dot matrices, and vector topographic contour lines. The clash between monochromatic disruptive camo elements on her clothing and the saturated, retro-futuristic pop-art backdrop creates an intense visual dissonance, emphasizing sharp silhouettes, paper cut-out edges, dynamic compositional balance, and clean graphic novel textures. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.

The image is a tall realistic smartphone interface screenshot showing a private WeChat conversation, with a clean white and very pale gray mobile UI and the familiar restrained green-and-white chat palette. The entire frame is occupied by the phone screen with no physical phone bezel, no hands, and no surrounding environment, resembling a direct mobile screenshot. Along the very top edge, a slim status bar shows the time "09:41" in small dark text on the upper left, while compact mobile signal, Wi-Fi, and battery icons sit on the upper right. Directly below it, a white navigation bar spans the full width, with a small black back arrow at the far left, the contact name "林小满" centered in medium-weight black Chinese text, and a dark three-dot menu icon at the far right. A thin pale divider separates the navigation bar from the conversation area.

The central conversation area has a very light warm-gray background with generous vertical spacing between messages. Near the upper center, a small muted-gray timestamp reads "上午9:32". On the upper left of the conversation, a small square avatar shows a young Chinese woman with shoulder-length dark hair against a simple cream-colored background. To the right of this avatar, a rounded white incoming message bubble contains the dark-gray text "你到公司了吗？". Slightly lower on the right side, a green outgoing message bubble is aligned close to the right edge and contains the black text "刚到，今天路上有点堵。". A small square avatar beside the right edge shows a simple portrait of another young Chinese woman.

Below this exchange, another incoming white bubble on the left reads "晚上有空吗？一起吃饭呀". Beneath it, a second incoming white bubble aligned to the same left margin reads "我发现了一家新开的日料店，看起来很好吃。". On the right side across from these messages, a green outgoing bubble reads "可以啊，几点？". Slightly farther down, the left-side avatar appears again next to a compact white bubble containing "七点怎么样？". On the right side beneath it, another green outgoing bubble reads "好，那我下班直接过去。". Near the lower middle of the conversation, a final incoming white bubble reads "那就这么说定啦～". The chat bubbles use realistic WeChat proportions, moderate rounded corners, natural horizontal padding, compact Chinese sans-serif typography, and consistent line height. Incoming bubbles remain soft white with subtle neutral shadows, while outgoing bubbles use the characteristic light WeChat green.

Across the bottom edge, a white input toolbar occupies the full width. On the far left is a small dark voice-input icon. In the center is a large empty rounded rectangular text field with no text inside. To the right of the field are a simple smiley-face icon and a circular plus icon, both drawn with thin dark-gray strokes. A thin gray home indicator is centered at the absolute bottom edge. All Chinese characters are sharp, correctly formed, horizontally aligned, and naturally spaced, while the interface maintains the understated density, margins, icon scale, and visual hierarchy of an authentic contemporary WeChat private-chat screenshot.
